title: Cairn Backgrounds Table File
description: Schema for Cairn 2nd Edition Background table data. A single file (backgrounds.json) holds all 20 Backgrounds.

attribution.example: Cairn 2nd Edition, copyright Yochai Gal. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Source: https://github.com/yochaigal/cairn

usage_note.description: File-level note on how Backgrounds are chosen and used during character creation.

id.description: URL-safe identifier matching the source filename, e.g. 'aurifex'

quote.description: The italicized flavor quote at the top of the Background entry, verbatim (may include a mechanical instruction, e.g. Fieldwarden's 'roll a second time on the Bonds table')

note.description: Optional supplementary rule referenced in Starting Gear, e.g. a Relic's effect defined outside the gear list

names.description: The ~10 suggested first names for this Background

starting_gear.description: Fixed starting equipment, always beginning with '3d6 Gold Pieces'

name.description: The table's question/prompt, as printed in the source

text.description: Entry text with the source's markdown bold preserved (e.g. **Item Name**) where the source names a specific item, creature, or vow before describing it
